name: ICPW Sunday Night Slam (Part 1)

matches.note: Four-way debuting match. Carpenter sent his two bodyguards to fight for him and was counted out when the referee ejected them; El Cu Cuy wandered out into the crowd and was also counted out; the Crippler submitted KeoX to win.

note: Opens with John Blaze's own promo challenging Retard Bob for the North American Championship and airing a grievance against his former manager Alan Soriano; after the four-way opener, Chris Kitching interrupts to taunt his own World Title tournament rivals. A hardcore match between Insane Wayne and Finnie Extreme begins at the close of this part and is decided in Part 2. Closes on the discovery that Blaze and a Syndicate associate have been attacked backstage.

name: ICPW Sunday Night Slam (Part 2)

matches.note: Hardcore rules, begun in Part 1. Insane Wayne won by pinfall after a top-rope elbow drop onto a steel chair, twelve minutes twenty-three seconds; a former champion then tried and failed to reclaim a title belt from Wayne at ringside.
Alexa won by pinfall after a dropkick-superkick combination.

note: A scheduled North American Championship defense by Retard Bob against John Blaze never starts, Blaze having been hospitalized in Part 1; the promotion's own president substitutes Alexa as challenger instead, and that match is broken up by Bob's own mother before a fall, so neither is structured as a match here. A tag main event between Brian J. Blottie and Chameleon against Thunder and Mangler is set up at the close of this part and decided in Part 4.

name: ICPW Sunday Night Slam (Part 3)

matches.note: World Title tournament qualifying match. Justin Russell, unhappy with both men's reluctance to fight, ordered them locked in a soundproof booth to be blasted with boy-band music until one submitted; Paranoia gave up first.

note: Includes a backstage interview with Bob Booreng about his own feud with the Syndicate and his arrival in the ICPW following a rival promotion's closure. A second World Title tournament qualifying match, Shaun McWhirter against Adam Alexander, begins at the close of this part and is decided in Part 4.

name: ICPW Sunday Night Slam (Part 4)

matches.note: World Title tournament qualifying match, begun in Part 3. McWhirter won by rolling up Alexander from behind after Alexander's manager, Drake Istenia, distracted the referee.

Main event, unsanctioned and falls-count-anywhere by the promotion's own presidential decree, with a guest hardcore referee. The brawl split into two locations; Blottie scored the deciding fall on Thunder after a tornado DDT through a table, with Justin Russell filling in to make the count.
